slides.title: You didn't gas out. You went out hot.
slides.body: Round one at sprint pace. Rounds three to five at survival pace. The clock noticed.

slides.title: Fresh legs lie.
slides.body: The first couple of minutes feel free. They're a loan, and it's due by minute four.

slides.title: Pick a pace you can repeat.
slides.body: If round one is faster than you could hold for the last round, it's too fast.

slides.title: Can you still say a few words?
slides.body: In anything over 10 minutes, you should. Gasping by minute three? Back off.

slides.title: Even splits. Then push late.
slides.body: Holding pace wins long workouts. Fading splits lose them by a full round.

slides.title: Spend your sprint last.
slides.body: Save it for the final 2 to 3 minutes. Then empty the tank.
